why: No major reviewer answers this exact question: Macworld's tested Apple-cable roundup names two qualifying cables in passing, and PCWorld's guide shows only a charge-only 240W pick. The top two slots are a duplicated review-aggregation listicle whose headline pick is factually wrong (Anker 765 is 480Mbps), the rest are untested roundups, single-product brand pages and retailer listings. A focused page comparing certified 240W+40Gbps cables by length and price, with the spec pitfalls explained, would stand out.
